mockHotels.name: Mirissa Palm & Coral Beach Cabanas
mockHotels.description: Eco-chic wooden beachfront cabanas nestled directly under coconut groves on Mirissa bay. Step from bed straight onto soft golden sand.

mockActivities.name: Kitulgala White Water Rafting & Cliff Jump
mockActivities.description: Conquer the thrilling rapids of the Kelani River in Kitulgala. Features 5 major rapids, tranquil river drifting, and an optional 5-meter natural cliff jump.

mockActivities.name: The Pearl Bay Waterpark Splash Day Pass
inclusions: All-day access to 14 extreme water slides
mockActivities.description: Sri Lanka’s premier European-standard water theme park featuring high-speed flumes, family splash zones, and an Olympic-size wave pool in Bandaragama.

mockActivities.name: Bentota Mangrove River Kayaking
mockActivities.description: Glide serenely through emerald mangrove tunnels along Bentota River. Spot water monitors, kingfishers, and visit historic cinnamon peeling homesteads.

mockActivities.name: Mirissa Blue Whale Watching Catamaran
inclusions: Cooked hot breakfast & Ceylon tea onboard
mockActivities.description: Sail out into the Indian Ocean to encounter the largest creatures on Earth. Witness Blue Whales, Sperm Whales, and pods of playful spinner dolphins.

mockActivities.name: Ella Rock Sunrise Hike & Secret Waterfall
mockActivities.description: Hike across active tea estates, railway tracks, and eucalyptus forests to summit the peak of Ella Rock just as dawn breaks across the valley.

mockActivities.name: Yala National Park Leopard Jeep Safari
mockActivities.description: Enter Block 1 of Yala National Park at first light with professional trackers. High-density habitat for Sri Lankan leopards, sloth bears, and Asian elephants.
